raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 and later include v2 collector rows, whose txn_ts is UTC, while legacy rows are America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions loads both without conversion. The v2 rows shift into the wrong local date and into 00:00-06:00, which causes the volume and time-distribution alerts; converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time fixes this.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
